summary: STP unit-config + aeration-video upload feature verified end-to-end. 16/16 backend pytest cases pass in ~3s. Frontend admin flow: SCADA diagram inline-renders capacities + Energy Usage 350.2 kWh/day + Gardening 45 KLD; Configure Plant dialog opens with all fields prefilled and persists edits. Aeration video upload/remove wires correctly via /api/uploads/aeration/ and toggles the Live On-Site badge. Non-admin client with view_water_quality permission cannot see stp-configure-plant-btn or aeration-upload-btn-{1,2} — passes ownership/role gate.

issues: Aeration Tank capacity label ('250 KLD') is rendered inside the dark-blue tank fill with dark text — legibility is poor. Same applies to any tank drawn with a dark fill. Consider white/high-contrast text or moving the KLD chip above the tank shape.

A large black rectangular polygon appears to overlap the Equalization → Aeration Tank corridor in the SVG (visible in the desktop screenshot). Doesn't affect functionality but looks like a stray fill.

action_items: (Optional polish) Improve SCADA diagram label contrast — dark 'KLD' labels sit on dark tank fills in STPPlantDiagram.
(Optional polish) Investigate the stray black rectangle over the equalization/aeration corridor in the SCADA SVG.
critical_code_review_comments: api_water_quality.py grew to ~770 lines — still readable but is approaching the 'consider splitting' threshold. _derive_stp_live_metrics is a pure async helper with clean fallbacks (auto vs manual, flowmeter vs manual gardening). Energy math verified: 3×(7.5×hrs) + 3.7×10 + 2.2×6 = 350.2 kWh — matches spec exactly.

Upload endpoint streams to disk in 1 MB chunks with a hard 60 MB cap and cleans up the temp file on breach or exception. Previous per-tank file is auto-purged from disk when a new one is uploaded — prevents disk leakage.
DELETE is correctly idempotent — verified deleting after tank_1 already unset returns 200 with success:true.

PUT /stp-config validates linked_flowmeter_hw_id belongs to an existing flowmeter — bad linkage returns 404 with clear message. `_flowmeter_daily_kld` uses max-min over TOTAL/VOLUME counter in the 24h window — correct 'delta' semantics.

GET /water-quality/latest correctly enriches every registered wq_stp / do_meter with _registry.stp_unit_config, _registry.aeration_videos and _registry.stp_derived — placeholder rows for devices with no live readings also carry the registry payload.

Frontend STPConfigDialog prefills every field from the last saved config (verified: 100/250/100/75/200 for the 5 tanks, FFP 300/3.7/10, gardening manual 45 KLD). Save round-trips through PUT and the SCADA diagram re-renders with updated capacities + energy total.

AerationVideoUploader flips the aeration <video> src to `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/uploads/aeration/<file>.mp4`, shows the aeration-custom-badge-{n} 'Live On-Site' overlay, and swaps the button label to Remove. Remove reverts to the built-in /aeration.mp4 demo clip.

Ownership + role gating is layered correctly: (a) client without device ownership cannot even see STP_TEST_001 / DO_TEST_001 in the device picker; (b) admin-only buttons additionally hidden by canManage={isAdmin}; (c) backend require_admin dependency returns 403 to any non-admin PUT/POST/DELETE attempt (verified in tests).
60 MB upload cap and mp4/webm/mov/m4v allow-list are enforced server-side — bad extension returns 400 with descriptive message.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (STP config CRUD, energy/gardening cards, aeration upload/remove, badge, admin-only gating all verified)
